description: Curated Korean-manufacturer specifications. Each entry is limited to the engine, years and drive types stated or reconfirmed by the linked manufacturer material. PS values are converted to kW with the exact factor 0.73549875; no tariff rounding is applied.

source.title: Kia Carnival KA4 2.2 diesel — provisional 2019 assignment
source.note: The two 2019 Encar records report 2,151 cc and the KA4 trim Noble Special, but Kia's first located KA4 catalogues are from 2020/2021. 202 PS is assigned provisionally at the user's request and must be replaced if an exact 2019 Korean production document is found. Do not treat this row as exact model-year official evidence.

source.title: Kia Ray 1.0 gasoline — provisional 2019–2021 assignment
source.note: Kia's official Korean Ray specification documents confirm the unchanged 998 cc / 76 PS powertrain for 2022 onward, and the Kia Heritage archive confirms the same Ray 998 cc model line. The exact 2019–2021 historical catalogue was not located; 76 PS is assigned provisionally for these years and must be replaced if a year-specific document shows a different output.

source.title: Mercedes-Benz E-Class W213 technical data — E 250, 1,991 cc, 155 kW/211 PS

Source is a manufacturer/dealer-hosted Mercedes technical document, so retain the normal preliminary-price disclaimer.

source.title: Mercedes-Benz CLA C118 official technical data — CLA 250, 1,991 cc, 165 kW/225 PS
source.note: Mercedes-Benz Media identifies the C118 CLA 250 at 165 kW/225 PS; Korean-market Naver specification data identifies CLA 250 4MATIC at 1,991 cc and 224 hp. This exact badge rule covers ordinary CLA250 4MATIC cards from 2021–2025 and deliberately excludes AMG CLA35/CLA45. Cards labelled CLA250 with 306 hp remain a review case because 306 PS is the AMG CLA35 output.
